skills.expectation: Write clean, reusable Python for analysis and modelling
Prepare and explore data with pandas
Pull training data with SQL, including window functions
Use hypothesis tests, confidence intervals and regression correctly
Build, tune and explain classical models such as trees and gradient boosting
Use scikit-learn pipelines end to end
Create useful features and avoid data leakage
Pick the right metric and validate models properly
Explain a model's results and limits to business teams
Train a neural network with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Build a simple LLM or RAG prototype
Design and read an A/B test
Process large data with PySpark or Databricks
